hook.convey: one whole stretch from start = 0 to finish = 1; stopping exactly halfway → standing on a real spot → 0 and 1 have no name for it → fractions are numbers that live between 0 and 1

use.hi: Cricket pitch ko ek number line socho: ek stump 0 par hai aur doosra stump 1 par. Batsman run ke liye bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka bhi ek number hota hai.
use.en: Think of a cricket pitch as a number line: one stump is at 0 and the other at 1. The batsman runs for a run and stops exactly in the middle. He is standing on a real spot of the pitch, and that spot has a number too.

use.hi: Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 km par. School bus aadhe raaste mein ruk gayi. Bus na 0 par hai, na 1 par, woh beech ke ek spot par hai, aur us spot ka bhi number hota hai.

point.hi: Screen par 0 se 1 ki line ab 8 barabar gaps mein bati hai, toh har gap pehle se chhota gap hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, bilkul 0 ke paas, aur beech wala mark abhi bhi 1/2 hai.

den 4 (halves halved, as in e2 and the worked example) → 2nd mark = 2/4 → same spot as 1/2; gap-value thinking, not mark counting

hook.convey: same 0-to-1 stretch cut into equal stretches; the stop is not the first mark but several stretches on → its name needs two facts: how many equal stretches make the whole (bottom), how many are covered from 0 (top)

point.hi: Screen par line 0 se 3 tak hai, aur har poora 3 barabar gaps mein bata hai. Pehle 3 gaps 1 par khatam hote hain, wahan likha hai 3/3 = 1.
point.en: On the screen the line goes from 0 to 3, and each whole is split into 3 equal gaps. The first 3 gaps end at 1, where it says 3/3 = 1.

prompt.hi: Gaps ke teen-teen ke group banao. 7/3 kin do poore numbers ke beech aayega?
prompt.en: Group the gaps in threes. Between which two whole numbers does 7/3 lie?

why.hi: teen-teen gaps ke 2 group 6/3 = 2 tak jaate hain, aur 7/3 usse ek gap aage hai
why.en: two groups of three gaps reach 6/3 = 2, and 7/3 is one gap further

problem.hi: Ek number line 0 se 2 tak hai. Is line par 7/4 kahaan aayega, woh mark dhoondo.
problem.en: A number line goes from 0 to 2. Find the mark where 7/4 goes on this line.

do.hi: Line par 0, 1 aur 2 likho, aur dono poore 4-4 barabar gaps mein baanto
do.en: Write 0, 1 and 2 on the line, and split both wholes into 4 equal gaps each

steps.result: 0 se 2 tak 8 barabar hisse, har hissa 1/4

why.hi: neeche ka 4 hai, aur 7/4, 1 ke aage ja sakta hai, isliye line 2 tak chahiye
why.en: the bottom is 4, and 7/4 may go past 1, so the line has to reach 2

do.hi: Upar ka 7 batata hai kitne gap chalna hai, toh pehle 0 se 4 gap chalo
do.en: The top 7 says how many gaps to move, so first move 4 gaps from 0

why.hi: ek poore mein 4 quarter hote hain, aur 7, 4 se bada hai
why.en: one whole holds 4 quarters, and 7 is bigger than 4

prompt.hi: Kul 7 gap chalne the, aur 4 gap mein hum 1 tak pahunch gaye. Ab 1 ke baad aur kitne gap chalne hain?
prompt.en: We had to move 7 gaps in all, and 4 gaps got us to 1. How many more gaps do we move after 1?

answer.hi: 7/4, 1 ke baad teesra mark hai, yaani 1 aur 3/4, 2 se bas ek gap pehle
answer.en: 7/4 is the 3rd mark after 1, that is 1 and 3/4, just one gap before 2

why.hi: 7 = 4 + 3, pehle 4 quarter se 1 poora hua aur bache 3 quarter 1 ke aage gaye
why.en: 7 = 4 + 3: the first 4 quarters make 1 whole, and the other 3 quarters go past 1

prompt.hi: Screen par 0 se 2 tak ki line hai, aur har poora 3 barabar gaps mein bata hai. 5/3 kin do poore numbers ke beech aata hai?
prompt.en: On the screen is a line from 0 to 2, each whole split into 3 equal gaps. Between which two whole numbers does 5/3 lie?

why.hi: 3/3 = 1 hai aur 6/3 = 2, aur 5/3 inke beech hai
why.en: 3/3 = 1 and 6/3 = 2, and 5/3 is between them

prompt.hi: 0 se 2 ki line par 1/4 ke 5 hop lo, ya 1/8 ke 5 hop. 0 se zyada door kaun hai: 5/4 ya 5/8?
prompt.en: On a line from 0 to 2, take 5 hops of 1/4, or 5 hops of 1/8. Which is further from 0: 5/4 or 5/8?

why.hi: 1/4 ka hop 1/8 ke hop se do guna lamba hai, toh 5 bade hop 0 se zyada door jaate hain
why.en: a 1/4 hop is twice a 1/8 hop, so 5 long hops go further from 0

prompt.hi: 0 se 3 tak ki number line par 8/3 kin do poore numbers ke beech aata hai?
prompt.en: On a number line from 0 to 3, between which two whole numbers does 8/3 lie?

checks.wrongIfMis: it cannot go on the number line

why.hi: 6/3 = 2 hai aur 9/3 = 3, aur 8/3 inke beech hai
why.en: 6/3 = 2 and 9/3 = 3, and 8/3 is between them

ladder.why: den 4 on 0 to 2, same den and line as e1, e2 and the worked example → 5/4 = one quarter past 1; smallest step beyond 1
den 3, no line given → decide before/after 1 from top vs bottom alone (4 > 3); moves the rule off the picture
den 2 inside a story: 1 km + half km → count in halves → 3/2; build the improper fraction from a real distance
den 3 again but out to 3 → 8 marks grouped in threes → past two wholes (between 2 and 3); hardest grouping

remediation.move: quarter-pieces laid end to end on a 0-to-2 line, no squeezing: 4 pieces fill 0 to 1 exactly → 1 is full → the 5th piece must go past 1; a fraction is a length, and lengths can exceed one whole

say.hi: Screen par 0 se 2 ki line par 1/4 ke 5 hop hain: pehle 4 hop 0 se 1 ko bhar dete hain, jahan likha hai 4/4 = 1. Paanchva hop andar nahi samaata, isliye woh 1 ke aage utarta hai.
say.en: On the screen a line from 0 to 2 has 5 hops of 1/4: the first 4 hops fill 0 to 1, where it says 4/4 = 1. The fifth hop cannot fit inside, so it lands past 1.

prompt.hi: Line 0 se 2 lap tak hai, aur har lap ke 6 barabar hisse hain. Runner 7 hisse daudta hai. Kitne lap hue, fraction mein?
prompt.en: The line goes from 0 to 2 laps, and each lap has 6 equal parts. A runner runs 7 parts. How many laps, as a fraction?

why.hi: har hissa 1/6 lap hai aur runner 7 hisse daudta hai, toh 7/6 lap
why.en: each part is 1/6 of a lap and the runner runs 7 parts, so 7/6 laps

remediation.move: same top, different bottom, on one 0-to-2 line in eighths: 5/8 → top 5 < bottom 8 → stops before 1; 5/4 → top 5 > bottom 4 → past 1; same top, bigger bottom → smaller pieces → nearer 0

say.hi: Screen par 0 se 2 ki line par mark hain: 5/8, 1 aur 5/4. 5/8, 1 se pehle hai kyunki upar ka 5 neeche ke 8 se chhota hai; 5/4, 1 ke aage hai kyunki upar ka 5 neeche ke 4 se bada hai.
say.en: On the screen a line from 0 to 2 has three marks: 5/8, 1 and 5/4. 5/8 is before 1 because the top 5 is smaller than the bottom 8, and 5/4 is past 1 because the top 5 is bigger than the bottom 4.

prompt.hi: Screen par 0 se 2 ki line par 1 ka mark hai. 0 se zyada door kaun hai: 3/2 ya 3/4?
prompt.en: On the screen a line from 0 to 2 has the mark 1. Which is further from 0: 3/2 or 3/4?

why.hi: 3/2 mein upar ka 3 neeche ke 2 se bada hai, toh woh 1 ke aage hai, aur 3/4, 1 se pehle
why.en: in 3/2 the top 3 is bigger than the bottom 2, so it is past 1, while 3/4 is before 1

remediation.move: train between stations: station 0, station 1, station 2; each station-to-station stretch in 5 equal parts; the train runs 7 parts and halts → it is at one real spot on the track → that spot is 7/5, a single number past station 1

say.hi: Screen par 0 se 2 ki line par har station ke beech 5 barabar hisse hain, aur station 1 par likha hai 1 = 5/5. Train 0 se 7 hop chalkar 7/5 par rukti hai, ek pakke spot par, jo ek hi number hai.
say.en: On the screen, a line from 0 to 2 has 5 equal parts between stations, and station 1 says 1 = 5/5. The train makes 7 hops from 0 and stops at 7/5, one real spot, and that spot is one number.

prompt.hi: 0 se 2 ki isi line par ek doosri train station 1 se chalkar 3 hisse aage rukti hai. Woh kis fraction par khadi hai?
prompt.en: On this line from 0 to 2, another train starts at station 1 and stops 3 parts on. What fraction is it standing on?

why.hi: station 1 = 5/5 hai, aur 3 hisse aage 5 + 3 = 8 hisse, yaani 8/5
why.en: station 1 is 5/5, and 3 parts on makes 5 + 3 = 8 parts, that is 8/5
